profile.selection: Retain every numbered raw dump and the Program termination dump. Select the one measured dump and three lifecycle dumps by the positive raw incoming edge into edit_sheets, using the measured or lifecycle parent respectively. Dump numbering is evidence only.
profile.scope: Guest-instruction attribution for the outer source-backed edit_sheets planning operation. It includes selector/catalog/closure construction and selected worksheet loading; staging, commit, publication, and reopen are outside this owner.
profile.claim: Callgrind Ir is a mechanism diagnostic. It is not a latency, allocation, hardware-cycle, or production-change claim.

rss.scope: Whole child process maximum resident set size, including benchmark setup and oracle work. The measurement is not an operation-level peak claim.
rss.claim: RSS is a process-level review signal only; it is not attributed to edit_sheets or any individual operation.

native_reference.source: 0708 ABBA native outputs from the primary native capture
native_reference.parity: For each matching stage/repeat/shape, profile and RSS reports must preserve the native reference case, corpus, source identity, sink identity, and output identity. Timing and per-sample fields are excluded from this identity comparison.

custody.source_policy: Candidate children require the candidate manifest exactly. A baseline frozen binary may run while the checkout is already at the candidate source; in that case the current census must equal either the retained baseline manifest or source-candidate.json, and every delta must stay under candidate_roots.
custody.binary_policy: Each child binds to the build-record binary hash. After owned binary cleanup, the same hash and byte count must be replayable from cleanup.json; custody mode is excluded from normalized identity.

gates.conditional: Run only after the 0708 native pilot has passed its primary gates.
gates.allocation_call_interpretation: disabled: the 0707 Callgrind allocation-call discrepancy remains unresolved; this packet retains no allocation-call comparison or claim.
gates.brk_segment_overflow: Record any explicit brk-segment overflow text in child logs or GNU time output; do not turn it into a numerical allocation or call-count claim.

execution_policy: This packet supplies refusal-safe, one-phase-at-a-time commands. The coordinator owns all native, Valgrind, and RSS executions; this planning agent performs none.
